source: blockwise-symbol-profile, MEASURED 2026-10-04 from the live editor (outputs/118/apply_report.json pin read-back; outputs/110/11_pins.json + 12_bodies.json for names/directions/lengths); every body box re-measured 2026-10-10 from the host's own per-primitive bbox (outputs/147/11_geom_bboxes.json, `sch.geometry bboxIds`). Built by tools/118_measure_profiles.py — do not hand-edit: a profile is a set of claims about one library symbol, and 113's hand-written ones were refused by 054 C6 on contact.

profiles.title:
Ground flag for the source-side (PGND) and the secondary-side (SEC_GND) ground families — 121b, 岳-ruled: the library now carries the rail/ground flags, so those nets are stated by one vertical symbol instead of being named by a label at every pin (tasks/121-hand-plan-next.md: 岳's 电源轨用竖直旗标、有旗不反复标; 069 sec.7: 旗标一定要竖直摆放). No pins: the connection point IS the origin — a pin-less profile is how the compiler identifies a flag — and the glyph hangs on the ground family's own side of it.
[121b] glyph box and pose measured on the live host, not assumed: 岳's own hand-drawn P1 page (outputs/111/geo_P1_live.json, 2026-10-04) holds all 11 of his PGND/SEC_GND flags at rotation 180 and all 4 of his rail flags at rotation 0 — no flag on the sheet is laid flat; which side the ground family hangs on is read off the host's own Ground-GND flag at rotation 0 (outputs/099/libprobe 2026-10-03 and outputs/089/draw/flag_orientation.txt, both measuring the bars at 9.5..19.5 units BELOW the connection; outputs/064_railflag re-measured the family on the canvas: 20-wide bars hanging 10..19 below), cross-checked against 岳's 110 page render (outputs/111/render_P1.svg).
notes: measured: the host's per-primitive bbox (sch.geometry bboxIds), stroke included, folded back through the pose (147) — outputs/147/12_live_bodies.txt
flag glyph convention of the compiler (the host places a power flag by kind+net, never from a library profile); the family is read from the symbolRef token GND by symbolprofile.flag_glyph_kind
